question: Can the already frozen PCHP deployment operator preserve its exact harm contract and improve its protected causal baseline on a new BaSyTec cell-aging domain, while a matched source-tuned unprotected candidate exposes the safety-accuracy boundary?

external_identity.title: Degradation path indicators for lithium-ion batteries
external_identity.raw_files: all 48 official Fxxxx.zip archives, each containing exactly one M0002_aging.txt

chronology.workspace_search_before_freeze: NO_SPECIFIC_MATCH for 15755725, dataset title, M0002_aging, or extracted_degradation_metrics; unrelated author and hash substrings were not counted

information_isolation.stage_1: The prediction program may read cycle identity and charge-side time, current, voltage, and temperature only. It may see the discharge-capacity column name solely to verify the frozen schema, but it must not read any value from that column.
information_isolation.stage_1_output: All feature rows, raw predictions, causal baseline, PCHP output, and source-tuned unprotected candidate are written and SHA-256 frozen.
information_isolation.stage_2: Only after the stage-1 report exists may the scoring program read cycle identity, current sign, and the frozen discharge-capacity column. It cannot rebuild features, models, parameters, or predictions.

structural_contract.roster: all 48 official Fxxxx.zip archives; no outcome-based file or cell selection
structural_contract.schema: BaSyTec text header must uniquely expose cycle, time, current, voltage, and Ah-Cyc-Discharge capacity fields using the frozen alias resolver
structural_contract.charge_definition: for each cycle, take the first contiguous positive-current block that passes the already frozen 600-second early-charge feature contract
structural_contract.prediction_cycles: all structurally valid cycles after the first five structurally valid charge cycles
structural_contract.schema_failure_rule: fail the affected cell closed and report it; do not add aliases after data access

target_contract.cycle_capacity: maximum absolute finite positive Ah-Cyc-Discharge value on negative-current rows of the same frozen cycle identity
target_contract.reference_capacity: median capacity of the first five structurally valid feature cycles
target_contract.target: cycle capacity divided by the initial-five median capacity
target_contract.invalid_anchor_rule: exclude the complete cell; never replace the first five with later cycles
target_contract.invalid_post_anchor_rule: exclude only the unscorable record and count it; predictions remain frozen

frozen_methods.unprotected_candidate_role: secondary matched boundary control; its result must be reported but is not a PCHP success gate

statistics.within_cell_metric: mean absolute error over all scorable post-anchor cycles
statistics.primary_estimand: cell-equal mean of paired within-cell PCHP-minus-protected-baseline MAE

retain_if_all: cell-equal mean PCHP-minus-baseline MAE is below zero
at least two thirds of non-tied eligible cells improve
the physical-cell bootstrap interval upper endpoint is below zero
maximum record displacement, observed absolute-loss regret, and cell-macro MAE harm are each at most 0.01 within 1e-12
decision_gates.reject: execution passes but any retain gate fails
decision_gates.stop_rule: Do not change the parser aliases, nominal capacity, window, anchor, roster, model, alpha values, delta, aggregation, uncertainty unit, or gates after outcome access.
